newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Cycle & Carriage sees higher '96 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Cycle & Carriage sees higher '96 earnings.

text.p: Car retailer Cycle & Carriage said on Tuesday it expected full year 1996 earnings to be higher than in 1995.

In a statement announcing a first-half gain in net profit of 14 percent to Singapore $96.0 million, Cycle & Carriage said the volume of passenger car sales in Singapore was expected to be lower in the second half than in the first and down by around 20 percent against the same period in 1995.
But "earnings from the group's motor interests outside Singapore are expected to grow steadily."
The statement also said further property development profits will be recognised in the second-half. In the first half, property earnings were up 29 percent to S$19.8 million.
